method: Session explorer 2.0 tooling, computed from data/sessions.json (per-session track plays + dates), data/v1/session-clusters.json (era, loudest + deepest-cut tracks, title-credited collaborators, deep-dive + journey links), data/v1/eras.json (era deep-dive links), and data/v1/codex-families.json (key sessions -> family cross-links). Powers session compare, the deepest-sessions editorial ranking, the track-level deepest-transmissions ranking, the timeline scrubber, and per-session play profiles on sessions-explorer.html. Play counts are the single 2026-10-11 snapshot; no per-track play trajectory exists in the archive, so none is drawn.

snapshot_history.note: The archive holds a single play-count snapshot (2026-10-11). Per-track play trajectories over time are not computable from one snapshot - no trend is shown anywhere on the page. Session play profiles are each transmission's lifetime plays in upload order, not a time series.

deepest_cuts.formula: average plays per transmission = total_plays / track_count, ranked ascending. Minimum 2 transmissions: a single-transmission session is a quiet single, not a deep session (stated editorial rule). Tiebreaks: lower total_plays, then fewer transmissions, then session id. An editorial ranking, not an artist fact.

track_deep_cuts.formula: individual transmissions ranked by 2026-10-11 snapshot plays, ascending. Tiebreaks: earlier upload date, then title. No exclusions - all 185 vault tracks are ranked. An editorial ranking, not an artist fact.
